fields.description: When enabled, Instructor-only users can create or edit Course Attendance only for Course Schedules dated today. Education Managers and System Managers can still correct historical records.
fields.label: Restrict Instructors to Today's Course Attendance

fields.description: Show the attendance reminder action when an instructor has at least this many unresolved missing or incomplete historical classes.
fields.label: Missing Class Reminder Threshold

fields.description: Optional same-site or HTTPS Frappe Insights dashboard URL embedded in Attendance & Students.
fields.label: Attendance Insights Dashboard URL

fields.description: Optional same-site or HTTPS Frappe Insights dashboard URL embedded in Exams & Assessments.
fields.label: Assessment Insights Dashboard URL

fields.description: Optional same-site or HTTPS Frappe Insights dashboard URL embedded in Fees & Finance.
fields.label: Finance Insights Dashboard URL

fields.description: When enabled, Assessment Plans created from an approved Exam Paper Requirement are submitted immediately. Plans created elsewhere are unaffected.
fields.label: Automatically Submit Plans Created From Exam Requirements

fields.description: Prevent official performance summaries from being generated while relevant Assessment Results are unresolved. Did Not Sit and Exempt candidates are treated as resolved without inventing a mark.
fields.label: Require Complete Result Submission Before Performance Summaries

fields.description: When enabled, an enrollment with a Batch but no Student Category is assigned to the least-populated matching Student Group while respecting capacity. A single uncategorized group needs no category.
fields.label: Automatically Balance Students Across Batch Groups

fields.description: Require Cloudflare Turnstile verification on the public Student Applicant Web Form. Configure both keys before enabling.
fields.label: Require Cloudflare Turnstile

fields.description: Comma-separated hostnames accepted from Cloudflare Siteverify. For production, replace the development values with the exact public hostname; do not include URL schemes or paths.
fields.label: Turnstile Allowed Hostnames

fields.description: Maximum public Student Applicant submissions accepted from one IP address in one hour. Frappe's built-in Web Form rate limit still applies as an additional control.
fields.label: Public Applications per IP per Hour

fields.description: When enabled, every row in School Timetable Generator and every Course Schedule must select a Room. Leave disabled for schools that do not allocate rooms.
fields.label: Require Rooms for Timetables

fields.description: Parent Department used by Get Departments in School Examination Cycle. Every active leaf Department below this parent is loaded recursively.
fields.label: Examination Department Parent

fields.description: Print Format used by the Bulk Student Report Card Tool. Duplicate the supplied format in Print Format Builder to customize branding and layout, then select the copy here.
fields.label: Student Report Card Print Format

fields.description: Optional Letter Head used for bulk report cards. Configure the school logo and header in Letter Head.
fields.label: Student Report Card Letter Head

fields.description: Salary Slip print format offered by the High School Salary Slip actions. Duplicate it to remove or rearrange details, then select the copy here.
fields.label: Salary Slip Print Format

fields.description: Target for the official school average calculated from complete Student Performance Summaries.
fields.label: School Academic Average Target

fields.description: Create or refresh an Academic Student Intervention Plan when a submitted performance summary falls below the configured trigger.
fields.label: Automatically Create Academic Intervention Plans

fields.description: Also trigger when a score is this many standard deviations below the course-group mean. At least five complete scores are required.
fields.label: Below Class Average Standard Deviations

fields.description: Escalate when the student's submitted overall performance remains below the intervention threshold for this many consecutive School Terms.
fields.label: Consecutive Low Performance Terms for Escalation

fields.description: Create course-specific attendance intervention plans automatically when a student reaches the configured consecutive-absence count.
fields.label: Automatically Create Attendance Intervention Plans

fields.description: Create a course attendance intervention after this many consecutive submitted Absent records for the same student, course, group, and instructor.
fields.label: Consecutive Course Absences to Create Plan

fields.description: After an action plan starts, escalate when this many additional Absent records are submitted for the same student and course.
fields.label: Additional Course Absences to Escalate

fields.description: Email the responsible instructor when a plan is created and email the counselor and academic management when it is escalated.
fields.label: Send Automatic Intervention Emails

fields.description: Fallback owner only when no single enabled User can be resolved from the scheduled course Instructor. Correcting the Instructor/User mapping is preferred.
fields.label: Default Intervention Owner

fields.description: Receives automatic intervention escalations in addition to the configured counselor and academic management roles.
fields.label: School Principal User

fields.description: Receives automatic academic and attendance escalations, including the original trigger and recorded action-plan details.
fields.label: School Counselor User

fields.description: Legacy setting retained for existing records. New intervention outcomes are evaluated from later performance summaries or attendance evidence instead of a manual review date.
fields.label: Legacy Intervention Follow-up Days

fields.description: Use submitted ERPNext General Ledger entries, Budgets, Frappe HR payroll records, and School Fund Requests. This does not create a second ledger.
fields.label: Track Whole-School Finance

fields.description: Company whose General Ledger represents this school.
fields.label: School Finance Company

fields.description: Optional school or campus Cost Center. When a group Cost Center is selected, the dashboard includes all of its descendant Cost Centers.
fields.label: School Finance Cost Center

fields.description: Income Account or group Account used to identify student fee income in the General Ledger.
fields.label: Student Fee Income Account

fields.description: Expense Account or group Account containing the Salary Component expense accounts used by Frappe HR.
fields.label: Employee Wages Expense Account

fields.description: Summarize submitted Frappe HR Salary Slips and Payroll Entries overlapping the selected School Term.
fields.label: Track Frappe HR Payroll

fields.description: Payroll Payable liability Account used by Frappe HR. The balance remains until the salary Bank Entry is submitted.
fields.label: Payroll Payable Account

fields.description: Summarize submitted student Sales Invoices linked through Academic Year, Fee Schedule, or Student fields.
fields.label: Track Student Fee Invoices

fields.description: Warn when overdue student fees exceed this percentage of invoiced fees.
fields.label: Maximum Overdue Fee Rate

fields.description: Once per overdue source invoice, create a late-registration invoice during the daily scheduler run.
fields.label: Automatically Invoice Late Registration Fees

fields.description: Submitted Fee Structure whose components, amount, receivable account and Cost Center are used for each late-registration invoice.
fields.label: Late Registration Fee Structure

fields.description: An overdue invoice must contain an item whose Item Code or Item Name exactly matches this value.
fields.label: Term 1 Fee Item
